| Part | Sequence | General term |
|------|----------|--------------|
| (i) | $2,\ 6,\ 18,\ 54,\ 162,\ \ldots$ | $T_n = 2 \times 3^{n-1}$ |
| (ii) | $-12,\ -4,\ 4,\ 12,\ 20,\ \ldots$ | $T_n = 8n - 20$ |
| (iii) | $125,\ 25,\ 5,\ 1,\ \dfrac{1}{5},\ \ldots$ | $T_n = 125\left(\dfrac{1}{5}\right)^{n-1}$ |
| (iv) | $-2,\ -\dfrac{1}{3},\ 0,\ \dfrac{1}{7},\ \dfrac{2}{9},\ \ldots$ | $T_n = \dfrac{n-3}{2n-1}$ |
